title: The Osirion at Abydos predates Seti I

tellings.quote: I don't believe that the Osirion was created by STI. I think it's far older than STI.

plain: The Osirion, an ancient stone structure at Abydos in Egypt, was not built by the pharaoh Seti I but is far older than him. The researcher Luke Caverns says this is his own belief, naming no source. If true, it would mean a much earlier people built it.
